resources.string: Claude PC · desktop Chrome · Adreno 830 / Turnip
Install the missing apps first, then run inside Termux:\nbash s25-desktop/install.sh
First run downloads the official installer into the Windows environment — this takes a few minutes.

The run buttons need the system installed inside Termux first (Linux container + Turnip driver + Windows layer).\n\nTap "Install now"; Termux opens and installation begins — it takes a long time, keep the charger connected and Termux open.
Installation started inside Termux.\nWatch the progress there — do not close it.\nWhen it prints "تم التثبيت ✓", come back and press a run button.

If the screen stays black: open Termux and run
bash s25-desktop/install.sh

Termux is not installed.

Get it from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store build is outdated), then run:

git clone https://github.com/basio96547/turnip-a830-s25ultra
bash turnip-a830-s25ultra/s25-desktop/install.sh
Termux:X11 is not installed — it is the display app.\n\nInstall app-arm64-v8a-debug.apk from its releases page.

%1$s
